title: Comment
description: A note or piece of evidence added to a task while the work moves. A comment is never edited or deleted; the one change it takes is being unpinned. Section 3.4 of the protocol.

pinned.description: Pinned when it was added, as a fact later work needs, and not unpinned since. A server at the Live work level answers it on every comment. Section 3.4 of the protocol.
